title: Tanzanian Baobab Juice
community: Coastal and central Tanzania — the ancient superfruit drink
author: Mama Salima
desc: Tanzanian Juisi ya Mbuyu — baobab fruit pulp dissolved in water and sweetened, producing a creamy, slightly tart, uniquely flavoured drink. The superfruit juice of Africa — made from the fruit of Tanzania's most iconic tree. Tart, slightly citrusy, and extraordinarily nutritious.
longDesc: Baobab juice is one of Africa's most ancient and most nutritious drinks — the white chalky pulp of the baobab fruit (Adansonia digitata), dissolved in water, produces a drink that tastes like a cross between tamarind, lemon, and cream of tartar. The baobab tree lives for thousands of years and has provided Tanzanian communities with this fruit for as long as human memory reaches.
ingredients: 6 tbsp baobab powder (or pulp scraped from fresh baobab fruit)
// Optional: a squeeze of lime for brightness
steps: Whisk baobab powder or pulp into 1 cup warm water until smooth and dissolved.
Add remaining cold water. Whisk again.
Add sugar or honey and salt. Stir until dissolved.
Strain through a fine sieve if using fresh pulp.
Serve cold over ice. Add lime if desired.
chefTips: Baobab dissolves more easily in warm water first — then add cold.
The drink should have a slight creaminess — do not strain too aggressively.
Fresh baobab pulp (seasonal) produces a dramatically superior drink to powder.
commonMistakes: Adding powder directly to cold water — clumps.
cookingScience: Baobab pulp is extraordinarily nutritious — containing 6x more vitamin C than oranges, 2x more calcium than milk, and high levels of pectin (a soluble fibre). The pectin is what creates the characteristic slightly creamy, slightly thick texture of baobab juice — the pectin molecules swell in water, creating a mild gel-like suspension.
sustainabilityTips: The baobab tree requires no planting, no irrigation, and no inputs — harvesting its fruit is the definition of sustainable foraging.
healthBenefits: Very high in calcium and potassium.
High pectin content supports gut health.
One of Africa's most nutritious fruits.
culturalNote: Baobab juice is Tanzania's most ancient drink — made from the fruit of trees that have stood for thousands of years. To drink baobab juice in Tanzania is to drink from the same trees that Swahili traders, Maasai warriors, and ancient coastal communities have relied upon. It is the taste of Africa's deep history.
